# Introduction to Real Analysis · MIT 18.100B

> Bilingual (EN/中文) real analysis study repo: lecture notes L01-L23, TBB textbook translation in parts, problem sets with solutions, exams, subtitles and proof notes.

## Lecture material
- [01-lecture-notes](01-lecture-notes): L01-L23 bilingual notes plus typeset PDFs and a progress table
- [02-textbook-TBB](02-textbook-TBB): Elementary Real Analysis (TBB) translated in 50-page parts
- [05-subtitles](05-subtitles): English .srt and .zho-hans.srt tracks for all lectures

## Practice & proofs
- [03-problem-sets](03-problem-sets): PS01-PS10 problem PDFs plus bilingual solutions
- [04-exams](04-exams): midterm and final review material
- [06-notes](06-notes): derivations on metric spaces, completeness, Archimedean property

## 备注
- Lecture videos are not included, only subtitles. Textbook copyright stays with the TBB authors and Rudin's publisher.
